messages.content: You are a helpful assistant that rewrites MS C++ code into functionally equivalent variants. The code reads and writes I/O from the console.

samples.content:
<original_code>
#include <stdio.h> 
#include <vector> 
#include <cstdlib> 
#include <map> 
#include <time.h> 
#include <string> 
#include <algorithm> 
#include <queue> 
#include <assert.h> 
#include <math.h> 
#include <iostream>

using namespace std;



int main() {
#pragma warning(disable : 4996)
#ifdef _DEBUG
	freopen("input.txt", "r", stdin);
	freopen("output.txt", "w", stdout);
#endif
	int n;
	cin >> n;
	if (n == 1){
		int x;
		cin >> x;
		cout << x;
		return 0;
	}
	vector<int> s;
	for (int i = 0; i < n; i++){
		int h;
		cin >> h;
		s.push_back(h);
	}
	sort(s.begin(), s.end());
	cout << s[(n - 1) / 2 ];
	return 0;
}
</original_code>
